verdict.rationale: Docs confirm budgets can be set per API key (docs-16) and per-key usage can be monitored (docs-12, docs-30), enabling agent-specific spend caps; a HN report even shows budget enforcement blocking requests at $0 balance (comm-1). However, there's no explicit evidence of rate-limit guardrails per key, only spend caps, so the 'runaway spend AND rate' guarantee is only partially substantiated.
